snippet.title: Life Dash | Gameplay Trailer #2
snippet.description:
Life Dash – Cozy Life Sim Trailer

From flipping your first dish to landing your luxury apartment, mastering mini-games, hitting life milestones—and racing to top the leaderboard—Life Dash turns everyday hustle into a cozy, competitive journey. Who will reach 100% first? 

▶ Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3589130/Life_Dash/
▶ Subscribe for updates, dev insights, and more sneak peeks!

What’s inside:  
• Character & difficulty choices  
• Mini-games like dishwashing & parkour  
• Apartment hunting, shopping, university, investing  
• Life goals and competitive leaderboard

Let us know in the comments—what life goal will you chase first? And don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe!

#LifeDash #LifeSimulation #IndieGame #GameTrailer #SteamWishlist #unity #steam #lifesim #cozygaming
